title: Uruguayan Hash Browns with Spicy Nutmeg
description: A unique fusion of Uruguayan hash and Spicy Thai flavors. Perfect as a side dish or breakfast item.

ingredients.name: Uruguayan Hash
ingredients.notes: Available in most Latin American grocery stores

ingredients.name: Roasted Potatoes
ingredients.notes: Dice into small pieces before using

ingredients.name: Nutmeg
ingredients.notes: Use fresh or ground nutmeg for best flavor

instructions: 2. Dice the roasted potatoes into small pieces and add to the Uruguayan hash.
3. Mix in the grated nutmeg for a spicy kick.
4. Transfer the mixture to a baking sheet and shape into patties.
5. Bake for 20-25 minutes, flipping halfway through, until golden brown.
6. Serve hot with your favorite breakfast items.
